relationships.evidence_quote: The levels of phosphatidylethanolamine (PE) (20:4) indicating arachidonic acid and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) in GDPD3−/− BMDMs were significantly lower than those in GDPD3± BMDMs

relationships.subject: GDPD3
relationships.evidence_quote: The levels of PPARγ protein and mRNA in GDPD3−/− BMDMs challenged with LPS were higher than those in GDPD3± BMDMs

relationships.subject: PPARγ
relationships.evidence_quote: GW9962 (inhibitor of PPARγ) reversed the effect of GDPD3 on macrophagic polarization, indicating that the modulating effect of GDPD3 deficiency on macrophagic polarization was through PPAR γ pathway

relationships.subject: GDPD3
relationships.evidence_quote: GDPD3−/− mice had lower mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity since CCI POD28 than GDPD3+/− group, indicating that deficiency of GDPD3 could relieve neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: both GDPD3 deficiency and CLB could attenuate M1 polarization of BMDMs under LPS stimulation

key_findings: Gdpd3 deficiency lowers DRG PGE2, shifts macrophages from M1 to M2 via PPARγ/FABP4, and relieves CCI neuropathic pain more strongly than celecoxib.
GDPD3 expression rises in DRG after CCI, paralleling M1 polarization.
